name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow Gai)
steps: Cook the jasmine rice and keep it warm.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and fry the garlic until fragrant.
Add the ground chicken and stir-fry until fully cooked through and no longer pink.
Stir in the fish sauce, then fold through the Thai basil until just wilted.
In a separate pan, fry the eggs until the whites are set.
Spoon the basil chicken over the rice and top each plate with a fried egg.
